h1: Merge a pull request. Get Pro.

p: A merged pull request in a public Hanzo repository earns Pro time, granted by hand by a Hanzo admin.

li: Level 1 Founding Contributor Your first merged pull request A week of Pro
Level 2 Founding Builder Three merged pull requests, or 1,000 lines merged A month of Pro, and Hanzo swag

p: Any public repository of hanzoai, hanzo-apps, hanzo-go, hanzo-js counts. The open bounties are scoped to start with.
Send the merged pull request. A Hanzo admin checks the merge and grants the Pro time by hand to the Hanzo account at your email.
